prs.route: Homogeneous scaling followed by Fekete-type composition
prs.exact_missing_full_statement: Determine sharp extremal asymptotics; an identified optimal delta with f(N)=delta*N+o(N) and matching bounds is sufficient. Unknown-limit existence alone does not determine the optimum.
prs.core_failure: No composition/comparison inequality with asymptotically negligible error forcing density convergence; no identified optimal constant.
prs.finite_check: finite-E302-check.json; exact all-triple enumeration with hitting-set recursion through N=30, plus independently readable small covers/disjoint edges in REPORT.
prs.outcome: Route tested; naive Fekete hypotheses refuted; density limit and optimal value unresolved

prs.route: Exact p-adic criterion plus simultaneous logarithmic recurrence to safe leading digits
prs.exact_missing_full_statement: For every N there is n>=max(N,1) with gcd(a_n,L_n)=1; together with the existing infinitely-many gcd>1 theorem.
proved_in_pass: a_n=U*H_d modulo p, U=L_n/p^floor(log_p n) a p-adic unit, d the base-p leading digit.
p divides gcd iff H_d vanishes modulo p.
For every fixed finite prime set S, unbounded integers simultaneously have leading digit 1 for all p in S; proof via Dirichlet recurrence, without independence assumptions.
prs.core_failure: The fixed finite prime set does not cover all primes up to its own unbounded returned n. No quantitative cutoff closure; new primes through n/2 remain uncontrolled.
prs.outcome: Unconditional finite-prime simultaneous result established on paper; full coprime infinitude unresolved

prs.route: Repeated-square divisor decomposition, fixed-gap gcd bounds and CRT
prs.exact_missing_full_statement: For every fixed k>=1 and epsilon>0, eventually product_{i<k} B_2(n+i)<=n^(2+epsilon), or a fixed-k polynomial-excess disproof.
proved_in_pass: gcd(d_i,d_j)^2 divides abs(i-j); gcd(B_i,B_j) divides abs(i-j).
CRT modulus does not lower-bound witness size: Pell x^2-8y^2=1 yields n=8y^2 solving coprime square moduli whose product is asymptotic to n^2/2.
prs.core_failure: Bounded overlap gives no exponent-2 control of the distinct repeated factors. CRT permits unusually small simultaneous solutions; required Diophantine size bound remains unproved.
prs.existing_partial: k<=2 O(n^2); failure of O(n^2) for k>=3; n^2*log(n) lower bound infinitely often
prs.outcome: Exact structural facts and shortcut obstruction established on paper; full n^(2+o(1)) statement unresolved
